validation.limitations: Live acceptance uses run-owned synthetic accounts and records. Populated graphs, qualification, unavailable/legacy scope and navigation use composed synthetic fixtures and tests. No real athlete evidence or access was modified.

recovery.method: Prepare a fresh forward correction from current main, preserve unrelated protected files, review a new hosted candidate and promote its exact artifact. Do not restore a historical Netlify draft.
